general_information.Syllabus Name: Blockchain Platforms_Giới thiệu một số nền tảng blockchain
general_information.Time Allocation: 15 hours (1 credit): - 10 online sessions (1 session = 90 minutes) - 1 final exam includes Theoretical Exam (30 minutes)
general_information.Description: This course help students to explore blockchain platforms including, 2 permissioned blockchain platforms: Linux Foundation’s Hyperledger Fabric và Microsoft Azure’s Blockchain as a Service; 2 Dapp platforms: Augur and Grid+ ; Important Challenges and solutions to develop blockchain platform; other decentralized solutions with Interplanetary File System (IPFS) và Hashgraph; and especially explore 2 blockchain platforms developed by Vietnam: Akachain, Tomochain
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students should self-study all lessons on LMS in time - Pass all conditions before taking final exam in campus

description: This course help students to explore blockchain platforms including, 2 permissioned blockchain platforms: Linux Foundation’s Hyperledger Fabric và Microsoft Azure’s Blockchain as a Service; 2 Dapp platforms: Augur and Grid+ ; Important Challenges and solutions to develop blockchain platform; other decentralized solutions with Interplanetary File System (IPFS) và Hashgraph; and especially explore 2 blockchain platforms developed by Vietnam: Akachain, Tomochain

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the goals and working of Linux Foundation's Hyperledger project
Explain the architecture and working of Hyperledger Fabric.
Explore tools and application development for Hyperledger Fabric
Understand a high level overview of Microsoft Azure's blockchain as a service
Discuss the architecture and working of the Augur platform.
Explore use cases for Augur.
Explain the architecture and working of Grid+ platform.
Explore usage of Grid+.
Describe a consensus problem and some of the existing solutions
Explain scalability of the blockchain and possible solutions.
Discuss privacy and confidentiality and their solutions.
Explain the escrow and multi-sig solutions in the context of smart contract.
Explain the structure of IPFS.
Describe the operations of IPFS.
Discuss the structure of a hashgraph.
Discuss the Social Imperative of Blockchain
Explore blockchain product of Akachain
Explore blockchain technology of Akachain
Explore blockchain product of Tomochain
Explore blockchain product of Tomochain
